source_name: Bančni vestnik – E-arhiv (electronic back-issue archive)
why_relevant: Deep historical run of the journal (issues back to the 1990s and earlier are referenced, e.g. a 2000-12 article on the history of Slovenian banking), giving longitudinal context on payments/banking structural change.

source_name: COBISS+ bibliographic record for Bančni vestnik
why_relevant: Slovenian union catalogue record gives authoritative bibliographic metadata (ISSN 0005-4631, publisher, run since 1952) and locates physical/library access to gated issues — a legitimate route around the paywall.

source_name: ZBS – Izobraževalni programi (programi.zbs-giz.si)
why_relevant: Training catalogues and seminar agendas expose which topics banks are staffing up on (instant payments, AML, ESG, digital onboarding) and which vendors/experts present — an early indicator of procurement themes.

source_name: GZS – Gospodarska zbornica Slovenije (Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Slovenia)
why_relevant: Umbrella chamber whose sectoral associations and sections cover ICT, business services and trade; the parent node from which fintech-adjacent vendor communities and their position papers branch.

source_name: GZS – Register članov GZS (chamber member register)
why_relevant: A member register at chamber level is a searchable enumeration of Slovenian companies by activity — usable to identify payment/IT vendors and financial-sector suppliers beyond the bank list.

source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT)
why_relevant: The ICT branch association inside GZS — its membership page and management board list identify Slovenian IT/telecom firms, several of which are bank/payment technology suppliers; the board composition itself maps the vendor hierarchy.

source_name: GZS – Zbornica poslovno storitvenih dejavnosti (business services chamber)
why_relevant: Business-services chamber covers outsourcing, BPO, accounting and consulting sections that intersect with financial-sector service provision; a secondary route to vendor enumeration.

source_name: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije (TZS) – Chamber of Commerce (retail/trade)
why_relevant: Retailers are the merchant side of payments; TZS is the body that voices merchant positions on card acceptance costs, interchange and POS/e-commerce regulation. Its 'T-Informacije' bulletin and legislation pages carry those positions.

source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija (digitalna.si)
why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder coordination forum for Slovenia's digital transformation (e-commerce, e-skills, cybersecurity, digitisation of the private sector). Its partner/coalition membership and project pages link public bodies with banks, telcos and ICT vendors.

source_name: AmCham Slovenia
why_relevant: Bilingual business chamber running commerce/digital summits (e.g. Digital Commerce Summit) whose agendas and partner lists name banks, acquirers and e-commerce players; a good English-language entry point to SI payments discourse.

source_name: Slovensko zavarovalno združenje (Slovenian Insurance Association) – members
why_relevant: Insurance is the adjacent financial vertical (bancassurance, payment-linked products); the association's ~25-member list enumerates SI insurers and its statute/reports mirror ZBS's role for that sector.

source_name: Združenje zavarovalnih posrednikov Slovenije (ZZPS, hosted on GZS)
why_relevant: Insurance-intermediary association hosted under GZS; illustrates the GZS sub-domain pattern (xxx.gzs.si) that many branch associations use — a structural pointer for enumerating further GZS-hosted bodies.

source_name: ZDU-GIZ – Združenje družb za upravljanje investicijskih skladov (fund managers association)
why_relevant: Asset-management association active since 1994/95; publishes fund statistics and news and enumerates its members (Generali Investments, NLB Skladi, Primorski skladi, Sava Infond, Triglav Skladi) — several are bank-owned, linking to bank group structures.

source_name: ZBS English-language site (Bank Association of Slovenia)
why_relevant: English mirror carrying About ZBS, Organisation and Guidelines pages — a lower-friction path for cross-country comparison and for quoting ZBS positions in English. Coverage is thinner than the Slovene site, so it is a complement, not a substitute.

source_name: Finance (Časnik Finance) — finance.si
why_relevant: Slovenia's only business/financial daily (Bonnier-owned; print discontinued 2024, online only). Highest density of first-report coverage on bank strategy, M&A, vendor selections, executive moves and quarterly results in Slovene. Specifics stripped from English wire copy typically appear here first.

source_name: Delo — Gospodarstvo (economy desk)
why_relevant: Leading Slovenian daily's economy section; carries bank rebranding, ownership, retail-banking product and sector-policy stories (e.g. Hypo→Addiko rebrand, OTP premium banking). Sub-section /gospodarstvo/finance is the banking-specific stream.

source_name: Svet kapitala (Delo) — Finance vertical
why_relevant: Delo's capital-markets and finance magazine; analytical pieces on banks, fintech segmentation (fintech credit, debit/account management, blockchain/crypto, capital-markets apps) and bank crypto/digital strategy. Better for interpretation and named-executive commentary than for breaking news.

source_name: Večer — Moj uspeh (business/economy vertical)
why_relevant: Maribor-based daily; its business vertical publishes bank-by-bank benchmarking journalism — e.g. the Slovenian digital-banking 2025 ranking (E-laborat study) naming leaders/laggards, gaps in PFM/budgeting tools (NLB, OTP), and weak digital support scoring. Directly useful for competitive positioning of Slovenian banks.

source_name: Dnevnik — Poslovni Dnevnik
why_relevant: Third national daily with a dedicated business section covering bank results, supervision, labour disputes and ownership. Provides a second independent Slovene-language read on the same events as Delo/Finance, useful for triangulating leaks.

source_name: STA — Slovenska tiskovna agencija (national news agency)
why_relevant: State-founded national wire (est. June 1991), reporting Slovenian politics, economy and finance in both Slovene and English. Most Slovenian bank announcements, regulator statements and results reach the press via STA copy first; it is the upstream node for Delo/Dnevnik/Večer banking items.

source_name: STAkrog — STA business & innovation portal
why_relevant: STA's economy/development portal focused on Slovenian companies and start-ups, with interviews of business actors. Good for fintech founders, bank innovation partnerships and vendor-side voices; free weekly newsletter lowers access cost versus the main wire.

source_name: Računovodja.com — STA news republication + banking/tax articles
why_relevant: Accounting/tax vertical that republishes STA items (visible /STA/Novica.aspx paths) and tracks banking-law amendments (Zakon o bančništvu) and financial-services taxation. Provides low-friction access to STA-sourced financial copy and to legislative signals affecting bank product economics.

source_name: Svet24.si — economy/banking news
why_relevant: Tabloid-leaning national outlet that nonetheless republishes bank benchmarking findings (E-laborat digital banking comparison 2026) with bank-level rankings. Useful as an access-friendly mirror when the same study is paywalled at Večer/Finance.

source_name: Cekin.si — bančništvo tag (personal-finance vertical)
why_relevant: Consumer-finance vertical with a dedicated 'bančništvo' keyword stream: fee changes, deposit/loan rate moves, branch closures and product launches. Retail-side signals that rarely make the business dailies but reveal bank pricing and channel strategy.

source_name: Siol.net — Novice / gospodarstvo
why_relevant: High-traffic Telekom Slovenije-owned portal carrying bank digitalisation and branch-redesign stories (e.g. Gorenjska banka digitalisation and customer-experience piece). Often runs bank-supplied material, which is itself a signal of what banks want positioned publicly.

source_name: Uradni list RS — e-bilten (editorial newsletter)
why_relevant: The official gazette's editorial newsletter publishes explanatory commentary on payments regulation (open banking / PSD-driven change and its marketing consequences), bridging legal text and market impact. Distinct from the gazette's statutory content — it is journalism-adjacent analysis.

source_name: Delo — tag page 'Slovenska tiskovna agencija' (STA republication stream)
why_relevant: A free-access surface onto STA wire items as republished by Delo. Practical workaround for tracking agency copy on banks without a full wire licence, and a pointer to which STA items the national press judged newsworthy.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of newspapers in Slovenia / Finance (časopis)
why_relevant: Cheap actor-map bootstrap for the Slovenian press landscape: names publishers, ownership (e.g. Finance owned by Sweden's Bonnier Group, also publishing Manager and Moje finance) and titles beyond the seed list, enabling systematic snowballing to regional and specialist outlets not yet covered.
